stages.name: Unknown
stages.description: The current lifecycle stage is not established by available evidence.

stages.name: Discovered
stages.description: Project identified from early public signals or pre-feasibility exploratory notices.

stages.name: Announced
stages.description: Formally announced by proponent or government sponsor via official press release.

stages.name: Referred
stages.description: Formally submitted to regulatory or environmental evaluation agencies (e.g. IAAC, CER).

stages.name: Early Development
stages.description: Initial engineering studies, baseline data collection, and stakeholder consultations underway.

stages.name: Feasibility
stages.description: Preliminary Economic Assessment (PEA) or definitive feasibility study completed.

stages.name: Financing
stages.description: Actively assembling equity syndicates, debt underwriting, or Crown financing facilities.

stages.name: Environmental Review
stages.description: Detailed impact assessment statement submitted for public and Indigenous review.

stages.name: Permitting
stages.description: Specific statutory license applications filed with provincial and federal regulators.

stages.name: Procurement
stages.description: Major EPCM tenders, RFIs, RFPs, or long-lead component contracts actively in market.

stages.name: FID Likely
stages.description: Permits in place, financing substantially committed; board approval imminently expected.

stages.name: Final Investment Decision (FID)
stages.description: Formal board and investor sanction to proceed to full construction.

stages.name: Construction
stages.description: Active civil works, heavy equipment mobilization, and facility erection underway on site.

stages.name: Commissioning
stages.description: Subsystem testing, grid synchronization, dry runs, and final regulatory certification.

stages.name: Operating
stages.description: Commercial operation achieved; regular revenue service active.

stages.name: Delayed
stages.description: Scheduled milestone dates slipped by 12+ months or regulatory process paused.

stages.name: Paused
stages.description: Development activities formally suspended pending market conditions or legal review.

stages.name: Cancelled
stages.description: Project formally withdrawn or cancelled by proponent.
